source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
As your opponent's turn ends, this unit may use this ability if it is **unengaged**. If it does:

- Put this unit into **strategic reserves**.
- It has **Deep Strike** until your next Shooting phase begins.
- It is required to make an **ingress move** during your next Movement phase, even if that is your first turn.
